hooks.command: if [ -n "$(git status --short)" ]; then echo "Reminder: uncommitted changes in nous repo. Update STATUS.md with what changed and why, then commit (or explicitly note in STATUS.md why it is being left uncommitted) before ending the session." >&2; fi; exit 0

instructions: This project uses the RIPER workflow with 3 consolidated agents (research-innovate, plan-execute, review). See .claude/project-info.md for detailed context.
